text:
maria: Hey team — we need a GCP quota + service account setup for a customer POC. Project: redwood-onboard-2026 (new). Region: us-west1. Required resources: 8 x A100(40GB) (sustained burst), 12 x L4 for low-latency inference, 2 static external IPs, and increase GCE API QPS to 2000/min. POC starts 2026-04-05. Can infra create the quota request and provision a deploy SA? @josh @ben :eyes:

josh: What's the expected sustained GPU hours/day vs burst? Also do we need H100 fallback if A100 not available?

maria: Mostly burst — ~12 hours/day peak for first 2 weeks, then taper. No strict H100 need, A100 preferred for this customer. If capacity constrained, fall back to L4 for non-critical traffic.

alex: I'll file the GCP quota ticket. Draft payload below — lemme know edits:

```
Project: redwood-onboard-2026
Region: us-west1
Quotas requested:
  A100 (type a100-40gb): 8
  L4 (type l4): 12
  Static External IPs: 2
  GCE API QPS: 2000/min
Reason: Customer POC to validate Dedicated offering; 6-week trial starting 2026-04-05.
Billing account: redwood-billing-2026
```

I'll include cost owner and support contact.

infra-bot: Created internal ticket Q-3421 and GCP support case 02-ABCD-6789. Link: https://internal.redwood/q/Q-3421 :robot_face:

ben: For the deploy SA, what perms? I usually attach roles/compute.admin + roles/iam.serviceAccountUser + roles/storage.admin. Confirm and I'll provision. Example:

```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-onboard-2026 \
  --member="serviceAccount:deploy-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/compute.admin"
```

maria: That set looks right. Also need the SA key rotated automatically and put into our secret manager. Add role roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor.

ben: added secretmanager role to the checklist. Will create SA and upload key to secrets with a 7-day TTL and label 'onboard-poc'.

josh: Also flag to network team — request subnet for GPUs with private Google access and ensure Egress NAT of at least 10 Gbps. @netops

alex: Noted — I'll cc netops on the GCP case.

maria: Thanks everyone. If Q-3421 moves, ping here. :thumbsup:
